{{ModBox}}
The '''Bore''' mod increases {{D|Puncture}} damage of a pistol by 20% per rank for a maximum of 120% at Rank 5.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Effect
! [[Mods#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +20% || 6
|-
| 1 || +40% || 7
|-
| 2 || +60% || 8
|-
| 3 || +80% || 9
|-
| 4 || +100% || 10
|-
| 5 || +120% || 11
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Acquisition==
*This mod was acquired by surviving at least 30 minutes in the [[Operation: Mutalist Incursions]] Event.
* Obtainable from re-accruing [[Razorback Armada]]
**Was also obtainable from the [[Tactical Alert#Divine Will|Divine Will]] Tactical Alert.

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|No Return}} and {{M|Jugulus Spines}} to provide a 300% increase to {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*When calculating total raw damage, a weapon will require a Puncture damage percentage equal to 75% of its total base damage to equal the raw damage increase provided by a standard elemental mod (which increases corresponding elemental damages by 90%). The higher the Puncture damage percentage over 75%, the more viable this mod will be as opposed to an elemental mod, and vice versa for lower values. These calculations only pertain to raw damage, and do not take into consideration enemy armor/flesh/shield damage multipliers.

==Trivia==
*One of the few mods that depicts a Warframe with non-standard color schemes, in this case a {{WF|Nyx}} with her Immortal skin.

==Bugs==
*This mod appears to have no effect on the {{Weapon|Burst Laser}}.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|15.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

==See also==
*{{M|No Return}}, another {{D|Puncture}} damage modifier for pistols.

{{ModBox}}
'''Breach Loader''' is a [[mod]] that increases {{D|Puncture}} damage of a shotgun by 20% per rank for a maximum of 120% at Rank 5.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-

==Acquisition==
*This mod was acquired by surviving at least 30 minutes in the [[Operation: Mutalist Incursions]] Event.
*Can also be obtained in the [[Tactical Alert]] ([[Tactical Alert#Divine Will|Divine Will]]) as a rare drop from completing the [[Razorback]] assassination mission.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|Accelerated Blast}} and {{M|Flechette}} to provide a 270% increase to {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*This is best suited for the {{Weapon|Cedo}} due to its primary fire's base of entirely {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*When calculating total raw damage, a weapon will require a Puncture damage percentage equal to 75% of its total base damage to equal the raw damage increase provided by a standard elemental mod (which increases corresponding elemental damages by 90%). The higher the Puncture damage percentage over 75%, the more viable this mod will be as opposed to an elemental mod, and vice versa for lower values. These calculations only pertain to raw damage and do not take into consideration enemy armor/flesh/shield damage multipliers.

==Trivia==
*One of the few mods that depict a Warframe with non-standard color schemes, in this case a {{WF|Nyx}} with her Immortal skin.
*''[[wikipedia:Breechloader|Breechloader]]'' is the correct spelling. A ''bre'''e'''ch'' is the part of a cannon behind the bore. A ''bre'''a'''ch'' is an act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct; or a gap in a wall, barrier, or defense, especially one made by an attacking army.
**This likely an intended deviation, as the mod does not affect reload. The name simply being a wordplay that combines gun terminology with a word related to puncture.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|15.8}}
*Fixed the Breach Loader Mod showing an incorrect description in the Arsenal.

{{ver|15.5}}
*Introduced along with [[Operation: Mutalist Incursions]] Event.
}}

==See also==
*{{M|Flechette}}, another {{D|Puncture}} damage modifier for shotguns.
*{{M|Accelerated Blast}}, a Nightmare mod increasing [[Fire Rate]] and {{D|Puncture}} damage for shotguns.
